veranderings.blok: Praat oor julle eie en mekaar se optredes
veranderings.na: Die drama in kwartaal 3 het uit
veranderings.rede: A term used as possessor ('Kwartaal 3 se drama') reads wooden; 'die drama in kwartaal 3' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing with the same meaning.

vlae.teks: Die geskraapte bottel klink grof as jy oor sy riwwe skraap.
vlae.rede: 'geskraapte' and 'skraap' repeat in one short sentence; if 'geskraapte bottel' is not a settled name from earlier lessons, a form such as 'skraapbottel' may read better, but I cannot tell whether the name is shared, so I did not change it.
